rule: A voltage always says its unit: Vrms, Vpk or Vpp. There is no fixed conversion between them (Vrms = Vpp / 2*sqrt(2) holds only for a sine), so a value is never converted and never stored without its unit (owner, 2026-11-06).

Vrms is the default: RatedVoltage, port Voltage and power.voltage_v are RMS volts, written as IfcElectricVoltageMeasure with no per-property Unit, so the project's SI volt applies and the house convention reads it as RMS.

Vpp and Vpk are declared units: one IfcContextDependentUnit each (UnitType ELECTRICVOLTAGEUNIT, the volt's dimensions, Name 'Vpp' / 'Vpk'), and a property holding such a value points at it through IfcPropertySingleValue.Unit.

Levels (dBm, dBu, dBV) have no IFC measure: the value is IfcReal and its IfcPropertySingleValue.Unit is a dimensionless IfcContextDependentUnit (UnitType USERDEFINED) named for the reference. dBm is referred to 1 mW, dBu to 0.775 Vrms, dBV to 1 Vrms. Never converted between each other.
In part JSON a voltage or level that is not Vrms carries its unit beside it: {"value": 10, "unit": "Vpp"}. A bare number in a field declared Vpp/Vpk/dB* is rejected.
Impedance is IfcElectricResistanceMeasure in ohm (the project's SI ohm); no context unit needed.
Project units (IfcSIUnit): length mm, mass kg, power W, voltage V (rms), current A, frequency Hz, resistance ohm.

Vrms.note: The project volt. No IfcPropertySingleValue.Unit is written: the default is RMS.

Vpp.Name: Vpp
Vpp.note: Peak-to-peak volts. Attached via IfcPropertySingleValue.Unit; never converted to Vrms.

Vpk.Name: Vpk
Vpk.note: Peak volts. Attached via IfcPropertySingleValue.Unit; never converted to Vrms.

dBm.Name: dBm
dBm.note: Power level, dB re 1 mW (into the stated impedance).

dBu.Name: dBu
dBu.note: Voltage level, dB re 0.775 Vrms (pro-audio line level, +4 dBu nominal).

dBV.Name: dBV
dBV.note: Voltage level, dB re 1 Vrms (consumer line level, -10 dBV nominal).
